title: hermes-jetstream wake route
description: One entry of plugins.entries.hermes-jetstream.settings.wake (or platforms.jetstream.extra.wake). Hand-written mirror of WakeRoute.from_dict in plugin/hermes_jetstream/config.py — that parser is the source of truth; regenerate this file whenever it changes. Validate a settings block before the restart gate with: python3 scripts/validate_settings.py settings.json

name.description: Route identity (also the rate/coalesce bucket key and the jetstream:<route> allowlist entry).

subject.description: Literal or wildcard subject; must match a subscribe_allowed pattern or wakes are silently acked and dropped at runtime.

durable.description: Durable consumer AND queue-group name. Parser rejects '*', '>' and whitespace (NATS consumer-name rules) at load, not at connect.

prompt.description: Template; single-brace {subject} {payload} {seq} {ts} only — never raw payload concat.

max_payload_chars.description: Payload truncation into the prompt; the parser clamps below 64 up to 64.

rate_per_min.description: Per-route token bucket; excess is acked and dropped (shed). Parser clamps below 1 up to 1.

min_interval_s.description: Coalescing: events closer than this are acked and dropped. Parser clamps negatives to 0.

job.description: Cron job id/name: route becomes an EVENT JOB (fires the job via the execute_job_for_event rail) instead of waking a session.

profile.description: Profile owning the cron job (event jobs only).
